name: sealed-settings-php-complete-keyset
prompt: I'm adding praetorius/vite-asset-collector to this TYPO3 gold-standard site. config/system/settings.php is committed read-only (chmod 0444). What do I need to do in settings.php before requiring the extension, and what happens if I skip it?

assertions.description: Knows settings.php is sealed read-only (0444) and needs a temporary chmod to edit intentionally
Requires pre-populating the COMPLETE ext-config key set from ext_conf_template.txt, not just the overridden keys
Names the actual failure mode -- a missing key triggers a write attempt on the sealed file, producing an uncaught HTTP 500

name: settings-php-checkout-reseal
prompt: After a git checkout or a fresh clone, our sealed settings.php always comes back writable and TYPO3 keeps mangling it. Why, and what's the fix?

assertions.description: Recommends a post-checkout git hook to re-seal the file on every checkout
Explains git does not store the file's permission/mode bit, so the seal doesn't survive a checkout

name: compose-yaml-not-docker-compose-yml
prompt: Review this TYPO3 site repo's container setup for gold-standard conformance. It has a docker-compose.yml at the root.

assertions.description: Flags the filename -- the gold standard wants compose.yaml, not docker-compose.yml
Explicitly recommends renaming rather than leaving it as-is

name: third-party-image-digest-pinning
prompt: Our compose.yaml uses `image: postgres:latest`. Is that conformant for a gold-standard TYPO3 site?

assertions.description: Requires pinning third-party images by @sha256 digest (or at minimum a non-floating tag)
Flags the floating :latest tag as the problem

name: first-party-registry-floating-tag-exception
prompt: Can our own registry.netresearch.de/typo3-sitepackage image track a floating tag, or does every image need a digest pin?

assertions.description: Knows the specific exception -- first-party images on this internal registry may track a floating tag
Explains the exception is because first-party images are internal and trusted, unlike third-party ones

name: no-direct-docker-socket-mount
prompt: A service in our compose.yaml mounts /var/run/docker.sock directly so it can manage sibling containers (e.g. the scheduler). Conformant?

assertions.description: Correct pattern for a service needing Docker API access is via a socket-proxy, not a direct docker.sock mount
Flags the direct docker.sock mount as a violation

name: settings-php-secret-free-env-driven
prompt: Our config/system/settings.php has the database password hardcoded as a literal string. What's wrong, and how should it be done instead?

assertions.description: settings.php must be secret-free and env-driven, not contain literal credentials
Names this as a committed-secret violation

name: extension-setup-not-a-seal-safe-alternative
prompt: Instead of manually editing settings.php, can I just run `typo3 extension:setup` to populate the new extension's config?

assertions.description: Names the specific TYPO3 CLI command being asked about
Explicitly rejects it -- extension:setup writes settings.php by design, defeating the seal

name: site-vs-extension-scope-gate
prompt: Can I use this skill to assess an ext_emconf.php-based TYPO3 extension repo (a library, not a deployable project) for conformance?

assertions.description: Gates correctly to the sibling skill for extension-scoped repos -- this skill covers site/project repos only
States this skill does not apply to a pure extension repo

name: bundled-checker-no-external-checkout
prompt: How do I actually run the automated conformance check against a site repo, without checking out anything external first?

assertions.description: Names the bundled checker script that ships inside the skill itself
Names the only external dependency the checker needs

name: valkey-not-redis
prompt: Our TYPO3 site uses Redis for caching. Does the gold standard require a specific cache backend?

assertions.description: The gold standard specifies Valkey, not Redis, for the deploy family
Also expects auth and eviction configuration on the cache service

name: valkey-no-persistence-cache-only
prompt: Should our Valkey cache instance persist data to disk, and what eviction policy should it use?

assertions.description: The cache-only Valkey instance should run without persistence, since it holds only regenerable cache data
Names the eviction policy as the other required setting

name: architecture-rules-advisory-not-gating
prompt: The checker flagged that our TYPO3 site isn't split into three separate repos. Does that block conformance?

assertions.description: Architecture/estate-level rules like the three-repo split are advisory, reported but not gating
Recommends reporting it rather than treating it as a hard failure

name: ci-supply-chain-gate-order
prompt: What's the expected order of supply-chain gates in this site repo's CI pipeline?

assertions.description: Names composer audit as an early CI gate
Names Trivy as the container vulnerability gate
Names SBOM generation and cosign signing as later supply-chain steps

name: gitignore-excludes-live-env-files
prompt: Our .gitignore excludes vendor/ and var/ but a colleague accidentally committed a .env.production file with live credentials last month. What conformance rule should have caught this?

assertions.description: The STRUCT family's .gitignore rule specifically requires excluding live-environment files, not just vendor/var
Names the rule family responsible (STRUCT gitignore coverage / SEC secret handling)
